name: What are the common signs that my home needs interior repainting?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs that my home needs interior repainting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your interior needs repainting include faded or peeling paint, visible scuffs and marks that won't clean off, or a general dullness that diminishes the room's vibrancy. If you notice cracks or mildew, paint can also offer a protective layer once underlying issues are addressed. Additionally, a desire to refresh the aesthetic of your home or prepare it for sale are excellent reasons for a new paint job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include faded, peeling, or scuffed paint, a dull appearance, or a desire to refresh your home's look.
